title: Bilinearity of derived completed tensor and its rational Hom action
statement:
Let $\mathcal S$ be a site small relative to a coefficient universe, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $A$ a commutative ring, and $s:A\to\Gamma(\mathcal S,R)$ a unital homomorphism. Give module-sheaf Hom groups and their unbounded derived category $D(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-linear-category] the induced $A$-linear structures. Let $T:D(R)\times D(R)\to D(R)$ be the specified derived tensor obtained by localization of signed total sheaf tensor on flat-term K-flat homotopy representatives [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. Fix a finite list of global sections of $R$, and let $L:D(R)\to\mathcal C$ be its Koszul completion reflector with natural unit $\eta$, where $\mathcal C$ is the full subcategory of complete objects [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. Write $B(M,N)=L(T(M,N))$ for $M,N\in\mathcal C$.

The functor $L$ is additive and $A$-linear; each of $T$ and $B$ is additive and $A$-linear separately in both variables. For $p\in A$, put $S=A[1/p]$ and use raw scalar localization $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C[1/p]$ [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. For every $M,M',N,N'\in\mathcal C$ there is a unique $S$-bilinear map
$$\beta_{M,M',N,N'}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C[1/p]}(M,M')\times\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C[1/p]}(N,N')\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C[1/p]}(B(M,N),B(M',N'))$$
satisfying $\beta(x\otimes f,y\otimes g)=xy\otimes B(f,g)$ for $x,y\in S$ and integral morphisms $f,g$, writing the scalar factor first. These maps preserve identities and simultaneous composition, hence with object map $B$ define a bifunctor $\bar B$ on $\mathcal C[1/p]$. In particular $\bar B(f/p^r,g/p^t)=B(f,g)/p^{r+t}$, without any torsion-freeness assumption.
